title: 5G Network Slice QoS Admission & Emergency Priority Gate
required_invariants: requested_mbps <= 0 or available_mbps < 0 or reserved_emergency_mbps < 0 must raise ValueError.
Emergency slice ('emergency') may consume up to full available_mbps.
Non-emergency slices ('enterprise','consumer') may only use max(0, available_mbps - reserved_emergency_mbps).
Consumer slices exceeding usable headroom are throttled; enterprise slices exceeding headroom are queued.
